notes.observation: Unit 1 repeats the chapter title and begins with split `தி ருவாரூரில்`.
notes.translation_action: Use title as metadata; read the split securely as Tiruvarur.

notes.observation: Unit 1 ends `கூறி-` and unit 2 begins `னார்கள்`; unit 2 ends `பொள்ளாச்சி-` and unit 3 begins `யில்`.
notes.translation_action: Join as `கூறினார்கள்` and `பொள்ளாச்சியில்`; page boundaries are not authorial breaks.

notes.observation: Ka. Mu. Sheriff brings T. R. Sundaram's invitation; Kalaignar joins Modern Theatres in 1949 at ₹500 per month with an explicit condition that party work and meetings not be obstructed.
notes.translation_action: Preserve date, salary and political-work condition exactly.

notes.observation: M. C. Chakrapani and Sheriff introduce the tall, vibhuti-covered poet who becomes Kannadasan; Kalaignar immediately reads him as carefree and able to quarrel then reconcile quickly.
notes.translation_action: Keep affectionate teasing and later retrospective identification.

notes.observation: Narrator explicitly says friendship with him attracted Kannadasan more than Kazhagam principles and speculates that this may explain weaker ideological steadfastness.
notes.translation_action: Preserve this as Kalaignar's personal judgment, not an objective diagnosis.

notes.observation: Full vibhuti gives way to kumkum plus one finger of vibhuti, then to a bare forehead during the Coimbatore–Pollachi trip; narrator notes Kannadasan later sometimes resumed them.
notes.translation_action: Keep vibhuti/kumkum concrete and the temporal progression intact; do not caricature belief.

notes.observation: Kannadasan insists on speaking at Pollachi; opening line says he was born in the Chettiar land where interest is charged on interest; he speaks about five minutes and feels the Kazhagam stamp fixed on him.

Before Kannadasan fully joined, circumstances for founding the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam arose; both men went to Madras on the founding day, while Kalaignar planned to return immediately to Salem to receive his mother and wife.
notes.translation_action: Preserve sequence into v1-ch27 and domestic move.
